workflows.description: Trace the effective authorization decision and its operands in the supplied revision
prerequisites: A supplied read-only source snapshot; deployment exposure is not established.

workflows.description: Exercise an extracted policy function against controlled objects in a local harness
prerequisites: Bounded execution in your own sandbox scratch; network egress is available and any download or install must be receipted.
One suitable option: A bounded offline functional check of Python and the dependencies needed for this task.

workflows.description: Compare a controlled principal against another with operator-supplied credentials; local HTTP alone is not identity
prerequisites: Operator-supplied authorized credentials for controlled authenticated principals, used only inside the confirmed origin.
